name: DE
context: Germany electricity market dataset with hourly electricity price and exogenous load and generation measurements spanning 6 years (2012-01-09 to 2017-12-31).

endo.name: price
endo.description: Day-ahead hourly electricity price in the German electricity market (EUR/MWh).

exo.name: amprion_load_forecast
exo.description: Forecasted zonal electricity load in MW for the Amprion TSO zone in Germany, reflecting anticipated regional demand conditions.

exo.name: wind_solar_generation_forecast
exo.description: Forecasted combined wind and solar power generation in MW for Germany, capturing the expected renewable energy supply that significantly influences wholesale electricity prices.
